verdict.rationale: Firstbase documents a single compliance dashboard showing each state's status, requirements, and deadlines, with in-app actions such as expanding to new states. It also scans incoming mail with unlimited digital storage and markets everything in one place, which covers state registrations and received documents in one account. Nothing shows managing multiple entities from one account or giving a team shared access. missing for 10: multi-entity management under one account, team/multi-user access or role permissions, independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard and document workflow.
